name: Build CityCare single-file site v1
purpose: No site exists (site_versions = 0), so no done-when item is met yet.

envelope.stop_loss: Halt and report to Priority if spend reaches 8 money, 8 model calls or 25 minutes before completion_check items 1-6 all pass, or if one retry still fails any item.

completion_check: Pass only if all hold: (1) the file opens from disk with no build step; (2) the form has exactly 4 fields and none for symptoms or history; (3) submit shows the 'hospital will call to confirm' message and the code has no fetch, XHR, form action, localStorage, sessionStorage, cookie or beacon calls; (4) the privacy notice and demo banner are visible; (5) 112 and 108 appear in the emergency section; (6) every CityCare phone, address and ER-hours value is visibly marked as a placeholder.
